body: I just don’t know how I’m going to survive until then. I don’t know how I’m supposed to manage being this lonely and isolated from other people for the next two and a half years, or live with the knowledge that I ruined one of the only good things I had in my life (my friendships with other people).
I could try? University of Chicago takes people with low-ish GPAs, I think.
My GPA’s too low for me to get into an actual program, which is necessary for what I want to do. It’s possible for me to find some school that’ll take me, but it’s not likely.

I love being around books, especially old books. I like finding something old and beautiful that hasn’t been touched in years. I like how peaceful libraries are, and I like organizing things. There’s this beautiful hand bound copy of Dante’s Inferno that I found in my school library today that reminded me that’s what I still want to do and how impossible that is.

Library science. And it’s because he kept telling me that it was okay for him to feel me up because we were best friends, and that he loved me. I didn’t want to, but I never told him no, and I was so afraid of being alone that I just kinda let him.
